s1.desc: a snowy village street lined with igloo-domed shops under striped awnings

spans.notes: Pax walks up and hugs Polly (seen from behind) against the sky; the background buildings shift (compare 6/32), camera settles around f24-26
6 frames of the hug after the camera settles
reverse angle: Pax from behind hugging Polly, her face showing; slow continuous drift, every background edge doubled in compare 33/60, 60/90, 90/111

spans.view: with a low railing and shop fronts behind them

beats.text: Pax hugs Polly tight while she stands stiffly with a red handbag hanging from her fin
Pax lets go and steps back, frowning at Polly as she stares at him blankly
Pax lifts Polly's limp fin out to the side and it drops straight back down
Pax rubs his cheek with one fin and glances away, thinking
Pax turns to Polly with a determined frown, then closes his eyes with a small smile
Pax holds out an iced drink topped with whipped cream and a cookie toward Polly
Polly reaches over and takes the drink from Pax
Polly holds the drink and cookie close with a tiny smile while Pax smiles at her

spans.notes: compare 112/220: shops and railing overlap exactly. The cup and a shop sign carry an in-world coffee-shop logo (drawn in the scene, not overlaid)
